test_title: PYST 33: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 14 Mar 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: By selling an article at (9)/({{11)}} for its actual selling price, a trader incurs a loss of 10%. What will be the profit percentage, if the article is sold for 8% less than its actual selling price?
solution:
**Given:**

Loss = 10%

**Formula used:**

Loss = Cost price - Selling Price, when cost price > selling price

Profit = Selling price - Cost price, when selling price > cost price

**Calculation:**

Let the selling price of an article = Rs 11

New selling price = (9/11) × 11

⇒ Rs 9

Selling price = Cost price - Loss

⇒ 9 = Cost price - 10% of Cost price

⇒ 9 = 90 cost price/100

⇒ 9 = 9 cost price/10

⇒ (9 × 10)/9 = cost price

⇒ 10 = cost price

selling price of the article if sold at 8% less than the actual selling price = 11 × 92/100

⇒ Rs.10.12

Profit = Rs.10.12 - Rs.10

⇒ Rs 0.12

Profit % = (0.12/10) × 100

⇒ 12/10

⇒ 6/5

⇒ 11over5

**∴ The profit % will be 11over5.**
